blind.description: A completely wooden garden rake lying flat on the ground. It consists of a straight cylindrical handle connected perpendicularly to a rectangular crossbar head, which holds seven evenly spaced, slightly curved wooden tines/teeth. All surfaces are solid, smooth, and continuous with a realistic wood grain finish. No disconnected, hovering, or distorted parts.
blind.from_above: It resembles a stylized capital letter 'T' lying horizontally, with a long straight shaft attached to a crossbar adorned with seven small rounded teeth projecting to the right.
blind.height_vs_figure: Lying flat on the ground, it is only about 3-4 inches tall; its total length is roughly 2.5 to 3 feet and its head is about 1.5 feet wide, significantly smaller than the 5 ft 9 in figure.
